* Changed ``isaaclab list_envs`` inside a project to also list the tasks of the registry packages in the project's
  ``isaaclab-registry`` dependency group.
* Changed the dependencies of projects generated by ``isaaclab --new`` from a source checkout: they require the
  checkout's Isaac Lab release (``isaaclab[<rl extras>]~=<release>``) instead of ``isaaclab-dev``, so that they can be
  published, develop against the checkout through an ``isaaclab-dev`` dependency group, and select the checkout's
  extras with ``uv run --group <extra>`` instead of ``uv run --extra <extra>``. All generated projects add an
  ``isaaclab-registry`` dependency group and ``[tool.isaaclab.registry]`` metadata.
